content.bridge_context: Comparing different systems of government through history to the present.

units.title: Monarchy vs Democracy
units.explanation: Monarchy is rule by a king/queen. Democracy is rule by the people.
units.dual_language_instruction: Who decides in a democracy? / लोकतंत्र में कौन निर्णय लेता है?

units.title: Dictatorship
units.explanation: Rule by a single leader with absolute power, often taken by force.
units.dual_language_instruction: Name a famous historical leader who was not elected. / इतिहास के एक प्रसिद्ध नेता का नाम बताएं जो निर्वाचित नहीं था।
